name: Mortal Kombat 3 — Game Story
notes: Primary Mortal Kombat 3 intro/story text preserved by Mortal Kombat Warehouse. It states that Shao Kahn becomes frustrated by failed attempts to take Earth through tournament battle, uses Sindel's Earthrealm rebirth to breach the dimensional gates, begins transforming Earth into part of Outworld, claims human souls, and sends Outworld warriors to eliminate the protected survivors.
